kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue — total sales generated over the period.
kpis.description: Revenue increased 17% in 2025, driven by broad demand and customer inventory normalization.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Gross Margin — gross profit divided by revenue.
kpis.description: Gross margin rises 440 basis points to 61.5%, supported by better manufacturing capacity utilization and lower intangibles amortization.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.description: Calculated as (Revenue - COGS - R&D - SMGA - Amortization - Special charges) / Revenue, it rises from 23.84% to 26.63%.

kpis.name: R&D as % of Revenue
kpis.description: R&D expenses reach $1,766 million in 2025, or 16% of revenue, in line with the prior year (15.8%).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net Income — bottom-line profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income jumps 39%, from $1,635 million to $2,267 million, supported by margin expansion and revenue growth.

kpis.name: Diluted EPS
kpis.explanation: Diluted Earnings Per Share — EPS including all convertible securities.
kpis.description: Diluted EPS rises from $3.28 to $4.56, reflecting a significant improvement in profitability per share.

kpis.name: Total Employees
kpis.explanation: Headcount — total number of employees at period end.
kpis.description: The company has approximately 13,000 engineers, underscoring its technical orientation and commitment to continuous innovation, enabling strong positioning with customers.
kpis.signal: Approximately 13,000 engineers, a key asset for innovation and technological differentiation.

kpis.name: Total Assets

kpis.description: Total assets extracted from yfinance over the last 4 years.

company_description: Analog Devices, Inc. engages in the design, manufacture, testing, and marketing of integrated circuits (ICs), software, and subsystems products in the United States, rest of North and South America, Europe, Japan, China, and rest of Asia. It provides data converter products, which translate real-world analog signals into digital data, as well as translates digital data into analog signals; power management and reference products for power conversion, driver monitoring, sequencing, and energy management applications in the automotive, communications, industrial, and consumer markets; and power ICs that include performance, integration, and software design simulation tools for accurate power supply designs. The company also offers amplifiers to condition analog signals; and radio frequency and microwave ICs to support cellular infrastructure; and micro-electro-mechanical systems technology solutions, including accelerometers used to sense acceleration, gyroscopes for sense rotation, inertial measurement units to sense multiple degrees of freedom, and broadband switches for radio and instrument systems, as well as isolators.
